in_marathi.name: Jaishika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory over ignorance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaishika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jaishika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ja’ meaning victory and ‘shikha’ meaning knowledge or learning. This name signifies the triumph of knowledge and wisdom over ignorance and darkness. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu tradition and symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and enlightenment.
